doc: The ONE movement and feel tuning file (owner 11-08), read by scripts/core/locomotion.gd (Loco) for the farm avatar and every match hunter alike. Live: with the movement readout open (F7, or Settings > Controls), saving this file re-reads it within poll_s. Units: m, s, m/s, m/s^2; drags are 1/s (the share of the excess lost per second, exponential). air: accel = how hard WASD pushes in the air; counter = multiplier on accel for the part of your speed going against the keys (a backward drift turns forward in ~0.1 s); side = multiplier for the part going across the keys (bends the arc); drag = how fast speed above your run cap (dash, knock, launch) bleeds in the air; idle_drag = what a jump with no keys loses per second. glide (the pull toward where you steer is [game data], HunterMove.glide_accel): turn / turn_fast = deg/s at cruise and the share kept at the max; brake / brake_deg = pulling back past this angle brakes this hard; drag = how fast speed above cruise bleeds with no keys (back to cruise in ~1.5 s), drag_steer = the same while steering; coast = m/s^2 a let-go under cruise slows; catch = m/s^2 the canopy eases a fall to its sink rate (absorbed, never turned into speed; ours: the source clamps the fall the step the glider opens, HunterMove.glide_start_vy, and its fastest-fall half is locked); max = the fastest a glide carries; swoop / swoop_fade [game data] GlideDownwardForceSwoopSpeedTransferRatio / SwoopSpeedFadeTime: on a level-out, the fall the glider's own pull or dive built (never a fall you opened it in) becomes swoop x that much forward speed (half while overheated), gone swoop_fade s later (GlideLift). glide_carry: per hunter, speed above this carried from Shift into a glide bleeds at carry_drag (on top of drag), so a dash never turns into a long sprint. dash.jump_keep: the share of a ground dash's speed a jump out of it keeps (the rest is air drag's, Loco.air_step; 1 = all of it, a long dash-jump). press_buffer: s a press made too early still goes when it becomes allowed, the one window players feel for all three: past a dash's end while the hunter can't act (DashFlow), before a two-step's recast arms (ArchKit), before a crowd control ends (DashFlow, docs/decisions/0022); a cast-lock press buffer reads it too, and a kit that needs another window keeps a per-kit override with its source; source: owner 11-08 'recasts buffered ~0.15 s' (DECISIONS two-step abilities), the footage gives no field (decision 0026). dash_speed: per hunter, a dash's speed scale (its time stretches so the distance stays); the shape of a dash (ease in, peak, skid) is the hunter's source curve in content/rules/dash_feel.json. sources: notes only (never read as numbers): where each glide/air value comes from, settled or Not determinable with the frames (docs/SUPERVIVE_FEEL.md).

tenzo._note: Tenzo (dolm). r_floor: the slab of rock ground his R (Basalt Spine) raises under him on the press, the same frame (BreahSpine.floor_under): r m round him (abyss tiles only turn to ground), time s it lasts, warn s of cracks and shake before it crumbles, rise s the slab takes to heave up (the ground is solid at once), col its stone. rmb: Quakefall's held hop (BreahSlam): windup s planted in a deep crouch before take-off, hop_up m/s up off the ground, fall_k the gravity multiplier on the way down (a thrown stone drops hard), ease how much faster than its average the hop leaves the ground (its ground speed eases to nil at the landing), carry the share of his run the hop keeps, nudge m/s the move keys bend its ground speed by, dive_hang s he hangs at the top of an air press before the plunge, dive_acc m/s^2 the plunge speeds up at toward its cap.

sources.doc: Where each glide/air number comes from (SUPERVIVE_FEEL.md 'Footage pass', Nov 12 2026). Notes only, nothing here is read as a number. Trust order: owner > game data > wiki > footage.
sources.glide_cruise: SETTLED 5.0 m/s (Hunter.GLIDE_SPEED): [game data] MaxGlide 500 uu/s; [footage] ~5 m/s, run pace. Agree.
sources.glide_base_speeds: Not determinable (GlideInitial*/TargetXY* encrypted): glide.drag/drag_steer/max are ours. No player glide start in the hero-ref clips; Elluna 706.8 s dash-into-glide still decaying (11 -> 8 m/s) when the track ends.
sources.glide_gravity: Not determinable (GlideGravityFactor encrypted): Hunter.GLIDE_SINK 1.4 m/s is ours; footage shows only the height hold (Tom Kick ~14 s level) and lift (Zik ~1 s back up).
sources.glide_braking: Not determinable (GlideBraking* encrypted): glide.coast and glide.brake/brake_deg are ours. Tetra guide 300 s and showcase 1174 s frame-stepped: no player let-go or back-key brake.
sources.hoop_boost: Not determinable (GlideBoost* encrypted): no hoop or jetstream in any hero-ref clip.
sources.jump_hold: Not determinable: a key hold is not visible on screen. Owner: fixed jump, Space held never opens the glider.
sources.air_dash: Per Hunter (AirDashSpeedMultiplier/Clamp encrypted): Shiv ~1.7x ground (8.4 m / 0.95 s, dancer.md 303.8-304.5 s, 0129-0134), carried to the landing; Elluna 11-15 m / 0.8-1.1 s (mooshmoosh.md 731.1/706.8/735.9/745.1 s) = tender dash.air; Kingpin card 'further', air_k 1.35 est; the other nine: Not determinable, no air dash in their clips.
